name: Willow Springs Ranch and Coats Ranch Farm Stand
tagline: Willow Springs, Coats ranches draw a hungry crowd with farmstand, U
description: In Central Point, OR, Willow Springs Ranch and Coats Ranch Farm Stand raises Blueberries, Peaches, Squash, and Corn on a independent farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
